artifacts.summary: Adds a .claude-extensions.json source_dir fallback resolution route to system-defect-record.sh's Signal B --dispatched-agent branch, a dedicated four-case fixture suite, updated resolver prose, and an end-to-end deploy-and-attest pass confirming the fix resolves from both a scratch consumer-shaped tree and the real consumer repository that originally reproduced the defect.

completion_data.completion_summary: Fixed system-defect-record.sh's Signal B --dispatched-agent resolver so it can attribute an agent-definition file from a deploy-consumer repository (no agent-system/ subtree of its own) via a .claude-extensions.json source_dir fallback, reached only when the existing glob finds nothing and emitting the identical resolved-path string. Added a dedicated four-case regression suite, updated the governing discrimination document's resolver prose, and deployed + attested the fix end-to-end against a scratch consumer tree and a read-only replay against the real consumer repository that originally reproduced the defect.

memory_candidates.content: When a resolver's source-store-relative output path must stay byte-identical across two resolution routes (e.g. a glob route and a .claude-extensions.json source_dir fallback route), reconstruct the string from the already-known logical components (an extension key, an agent name) rather than deriving it from the route-specific absolute path that happened to resolve it. This guarantees shape parity between routes by construction instead of by post-hoc normalization, and keeps every downstream consumer of the string (a recursion guard, a dedup key, a persisted detail field) oblivious to which route resolved it.

verify-deploy.sh's gate 8 (tests/run-all.sh) supports --gate8-touched PATH[,PATH...] to narrow the shell-suite battery via suite_selection_select, independent of --only-gate (which selects which NUMBERED gates run, but still runs gate 8's FULL unnarrowed battery unless --gate8-touched is also given). Under a multi-task batch with a Batch Gate Deferral directive, always pass --gate8-touched with the task's own touched files alongside --only-gate -- omitting it, even with --skip-unchanged, silently falls through to the complete 200+ suite sweep and queues every sibling dispatch behind specs/.gate-lock. A narrowed run (via either --gate8-touched or run-all.sh's own --only) deliberately does not touch specs/.gate-lock at all, since suite narrowing already discharges a sub-full verification tier.

sapience_notes.subject: system-defect-record.sh Signal B resolver
sapience_notes.value: The --dispatched-agent resolver now has two routes: glob agent-system/extensions/*/agents/NAME.md (source-store only) falling back to a .claude-extensions.json per-extension source_dir lookup (deploy-consumer case). Both emit the identical agent-system/extensions/<ext>/agents/<NAME>.md string; first match wins across extensions on either route.

sapience_notes.subject: generate-context-line-counts.sh
sapience_notes.value: Refuses to run from the agent-system source store (deploy-root-guard.sh refusal); a source-store-only edit to a context file's line count must be hand-applied to index-entries.json's line_count field until a redeploy makes the real script runnable.

sapience_notes.subject: verify-deploy.sh gate 8 narrowing
sapience_notes.value: --only-gate selects which numbered gates run but does NOT by itself narrow gate 8's own internal run-all.sh invocation; --gate8-touched PATH[,...] is the separate flag that narrows gate 8 via suite_selection_select. Omitting it causes a silent fallback to the full 200+ suite battery even when --only-gate and --skip-unchanged are both given.

sapience_notes.subject: specs/.gate-lock staleness reclaim
sapience_notes.value: The gate-lock mutex's staleness window is holder-declared and defaults to 1800s (30 min); a holder process that dies without releasing (e.g. killed by an external timeout wrapper) leaves the lock held-but-dead until either that staleness window elapses or the waiting acquirer's own 600s acquire budget expires and it proceeds unserialized. There is no PID-liveness short-circuit -- a dead holder's lock is reclaimed by elapsed time alone.

sapience_notes.subject: test-system-defect-record-signal-b.sh fixture design
sapience_notes.value: Proving an internally-computed resolved-path string without copying a script's event-write dependency chain into a test fixture: feed the fixture an orchestrator-critical-paths.json marking the expected path recursion_guard:true. The recursion guard then exits 0 and echoes the resolved path verbatim in stderr, pinning the exact string with zero events-append.sh/events-query.sh dependency.

sapience_notes.subject: Live corpus cross-task test fragility under this batch
sapience_notes.value: A multi-task batch sharing one machine's ~/.claude.json/.mcp.json state can make test-mcp-merge-target.sh fail from concurrent-session contamination rather than a real defect, and a newly-introduced-but-unclassified suite-classification.data gap in one task's work (e.g. task 604's test-lint-fixture-dependency-declaration.sh) surfaces as a NEW gate-8 finding attributed to whichever task happens to run the scoped gate check next, not to the task that caused it.
